question: On the E10 long-meeting cases, does an arm where code finds and cites the evidence and the model only words it (team_rag) answer more than the routed team (team_routed) under the same conditions?

memory.note: Reuses the E10 memory cache (results/partial/e10-memory.jsonl, same key). cached_only: a case whose notes are not built runs every arm with no notes (the record counts them in timing.memory_absent_cases) instead of building them; team_rag reads the notes for topic questions, team_rag_nomem never does (the ablation). The extractor reads the transcript in chunks of 40 turns, each chunk seeing the notes so far; built before the press, outside the card timing. num_ctx 16384 for memory calls only: the largest QMSum chunk is 10487 prompt tokens (measured) and Ollama's default window is 4096. The cache key is the meeting words plus model, chunk_turns, num_ctx and the extraction prompt, never the commit. Calls get 900 s each (not the extractor's 60 s) and two attempts; a chunk that still fails leaves the entry unfinished, to be redone alone, and the card run refuses unfinished memory. Why: on 2026-11-14 a game was using the GPU, generation fell to about 5-15 tokens/s, 60 s calls timed out, and Ollama kept generating the abandoned requests. 2026-11-14 second cause: a chunk of long QMSum turns (40 turns = 5,779 prompt tokens) makes the extractor's reply hit its own 1600-token cap, the JSON is cut off and invalid, and the client's schema retry repeated the same long generation (2 x 130 s) before failing. Fix: chunks of 40 turns whose text exceeds max_chunk_chars (6000, about 1,500 tokens; a reply is about 0.75x its input) are read in pieces; a reply cut off at the cap keeps its complete items; no second generation after bad JSON. Finished cache entries from before this change are kept (their chunks parsed).

cases.files: datasets/raw/scenarios/e10/{dev,test}.jsonl (git-ignored: real meeting text; hashes are in the manifest)
cases.order: dev first, test once the configuration is chosen

card.note: Card calls use Ollama's default window (4096 tokens) for every arm, as in E8 and the product. Measured largest card prompt on the heaviest test cases (16384 window so nothing was cut): single 1019, team_shipping_changed 1560, team_routed 2376, single_plus 2118 tokens, all under 4096. A setting here would apply to every arm alike.

rag.note: Tuned on dev only; see src/contextlens/agents/rag.py constants.
